reviews.method: Source PNG plus actual front and side renders inspected with view_image; independent third-party image claims not used.
findings: The source has a single pair of hands holding the belly.
The reconstruction keeps the belly-holding arms and adds another pair extended sideways: four arms.
The actual OBJ has no material, vertex colour or texture files, despite requested PBR/HighPack.
100% quadrilateral topology is technically verified but does not establish character identity.
